text.offer: The bandits near Berg give honest outlaws a bad name - and they've been robbing our supply runs. Their camps lie in the hills toward Berg. Cut down fifteen of their thugs and ten of the snipers who cover them.
text.progress: The bandits camp in the hills and mines near Berg, and on Kardde's path and pass.
text.complete: The roads will be safer for it. But their captains still lead them.

steps.brief: Now the snipers - ten of them.
